---
name: triage
description: Classify an incoming issue and route it to the right team. Use when new issues arrive without labels.
---

# Triage

Read the issue body, match it against the support runbook categories,
and apply the matching labels.

## Steps

1. Identify the affected component from the issue body.
2. Match the failure description against the runbook categories.
3. Apply the component and category labels, or escalate when nothing matches.
